assertions.assertion: Registers the handler with AddSamlServiceProvider on the AddAuthentication builder
assertions.rationale: Registers a third-party `AddSaml2` (Sustainsys) handler, not the Duende `AddSamlServiceProvider` handler.

assertions.assertion: Sets AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse = true and also sets IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl (required when unsolicited responses are allowed)
assertions.rationale: Sets AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse = true but never sets the required IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl.
Uses a hard-coded "External" scheme string rather than IdentityServerConstants.ExternalCookieAuthenticationScheme.

assertions.assertion: Callback authenticates against the external cookie scheme and reads RelayState from AuthenticationProperties.Items["relayState"]
assertions.rationale: Reads from Items["RelayState"] (capitalized) rather than the Duende-populated Items["relayState"], so the key would not match at runtime.

assertions.assertion: Warns that RelayState is untrusted input and must be validated before being used as a redirect target
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states RelayState is untrusted, warns against blind redirects, and validates it as a local allow-listed URL before use.
